meta.title: Market
meta.description: Open Market in the left sidebar for quotes on China A shares, ETFs/LOFs, Hong Kong and US stocks, and mutual funds, with lists, intraday charts and candlesticks. Each security shows Turtle System 1/2 status, the 50/300-day trend filter, N and the 2N stop, the 1% unit size, probability ranges and its own signal history. Details also gather news, filings and events; hover a candle to see that day’s items and click to ask the AI why it moved. You also get a paper account under China A rules (T+1, 100-share lots, fees), a watchlist, alerts and rule-based screeners (Turtle 55/20-day breakouts, strong trends, ETF trends, mutual fund trends). The Live tab follows your real trades in China A shares, listed funds and mutual funds (the plugin never places orders; you record fills): it suggests a starting stake from the loss you can bear, gives a pre-trade plan, reminds you about stops, exits, adds and drawdowns, tracks results in R and lets the AI distil your personal rules; the AI only sees ratios and R multiples. The AI advisor chats about the selected security and answers with a clear leaning, stop and size based on the plugin’s built-in trading rule library. The plugin also registers market_* tools and trading_knowledge_search for DSH agents. Quotes come from public Eastmoney, Tencent and Sina endpoints that may lag or rate-limit; the plugin fails over between them. Each AI question sends one request to your configured DeepSeek model. Data is stored in ~/.dsh/plugin-data/stock-market, and turning the plugin off stops all polling. For reference only; not investment advice.
